verdict.rationale: Kintsugi tracks transactions and computes nexus by analyzing a rolling window of sales, and exposes nexus/registration APIs (kintsugi-docs-3, kintsugi-docs-11, kintsugi-docs-35), and markets itself as finding 'exposure you didn't know you had' (kintsugi-docs-15). However, the docs describe this as determining when you *already crossed* a threshold, not a proactive alert before crossing — there's no evidence of a notification/alert mechanism triggered ahead of threshold breach. Missing for 10: explicit pre-crossing alert/notification feature, real-time threshold-warning UI, and per-state/country threshold visualization.
